scope: Matched native x86_64 public consumers in a dedicated unchanged harness, including output materialization and tensor output consumed by further evaluation. Not a universal stack, firmware or RSS bound; compare emitted frames against normal benchmark artifacts separately.
source_of_watermark: /tmp/interval-refactor/interval-distance-certainty/stack-harness/stack.c; corrected uintptr bounded loops and two patterns, not the rejected original harness.
input_construction: Outside measured thread. Root validation precedes measurement; global/shared construction caches may be warm. Warm mode performs one complete callback before repainting.
decision: Compare complete outcomes and independent exact expectations, and per-case cold/warm maxima across all128samples per variant. Preserve each adverse row; no cross-case netting. Do not accept a higher persistent candidate maximum.
pre_execution_review: Aligned8repetitions with predeclared128samples per case/warm state; made evaluation status assertions explicit before any harness build/run.
